description: Return the site's last 50 deploy and snapshot entries, newest first: how each was triggered, label, snapshot name, file count and secrets detected. Each entry's snapshot holds the content from BEFORE that entry. Restoring is done by the user in the VibeDeploy dashboard within the plan's restore window; there is no restore tool.

name.description: Site name as shown by list_sites, e.g. my-portfolio. Provide name or siteId.

siteId.description: Site id from list_sites or get_site. Use instead of name.

name: list_history

entries.description: Most recent 50 deploy/snapshot history entries, newest first.

secretsFound.description: Potential secrets detected during the deploy that produced this entry.

snapshotName.description: Snapshot taken just BEFORE this entry's change, so restoring it brings back what was live before this entry. For manual-snapshot and staging entries it is the live content at that moment. To get an older deploy's own content back, use the snapshot of the next newer entry. Null if none was taken or retention removed it.

source.description: How the entry was created. Observed values: mcp, magic-file, git, quick-deploy, zip, ai-generate, staging, promote, rollback, manual-snapshot. Treat as a hint, not a closed enum.

title: List deploy/snapshot history for a site
